family: Drivers must be at least 14 and 1.50 m; under-18s need an adult present.
Children from 6 and 1.25 m can ride as passengers in the twin kart.
If weather stops outdoor karting, bookings may move to the indoor track, be rescheduled or cancelled.
Rental helmets are available; a balaclava is required (3 EUR).
group: The Grand-Prix package (qualifying, grid and race, up to 20 or 24 drivers) gives exclusive track use.
Company events, private events and weddings are offered.

family: Children must be at least 8 and 1.30 m to drive; kids' tickets are up to 13, adult tickets from 14.

Kids' birthday packages (6-13 years, from 6 children) include awards and sweets; own food and drinks are not allowed.
Ticket rides can be limited during club and cup events.
group: Company events and monthly hobby races open to all levels are offered.
Combo tickets with laser tag are available.

group: Group and company events are run on the large karts only (from 160 cm).
